articles.headline: Mammoth's Mikhail Sergachev exits after taking puck to helmet
articles.description: Utah Mammoth defenseman Mikhail Sergachev left Tuesday night's 5-3 win over New Jersey after being struck on the back of the helmet by a puck.

articles.headline: Rinzel and Frondell score, Blackhawks beat Blues 4-2 in Kane's return to Chicago
articles.description: — Sam Rinzel and rookie Anton Frondell scored 2 minutes apart in the second period and the Chicago Blackhawks held on in their home opener for their first win of the season, 4-2 over the St. Louis Blues on Tuesday night.
